title: Under durationPolicy perTick a shorter duration mid-run finishes the recipe at once
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `durationPolicy: perTick` で進捗バーが飛ぶ; docs/jp/structures/JSON_FORMAT.md durationPolicy (perTick re-evaluates every tick; CAUTION: once the value drops below the work already done the recipe completes); docs/jp/recipes/EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md §5 評価タイミング `duration` (line 311); count_blocks lags up to 20 ticks (EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md 周囲を調べる関数, docs/en/recipes/CONDITIONS.md §5 Tips). Gold at t=40 is read by t=60 at the latest; by then 40+ work is done, so the 40-tick duration completes the recipe well before t=110 instead of t≈400

title: Under durationPolicy onStart the same recipe keeps its 400-tick duration after gold arrives
source: run/TESTING.md §6 タイミング `durationPolicy: perTick` で進捗バーが飛ぶ (control); docs/jp/structures/JSON_FORMAT.md durationPolicy (onStart evaluates once at the start and keeps it for the run); docs/jp/recipes/EXPRESSION_REFERENCE.md §5 評価タイミング `duration` (line 311). Progress stays on the 400-tick line: ~0.075 at t=30, ~0.25 at t=100, and nothing is output by t=110
